# Vauxhall

Vauxhall is described by its recorded input as a clean, cool visual theme with subtle personality. Base colour palettes, three background intensities and several header styles are chosen through the Style Settings plugin, and that input also names colour variations and an optional snippet that colours the sidebar.

![Vauxhall screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyanvoxel/vauxhall-obsidian/HEAD/cover.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Vauxhall"
    author: "cyanvoxel"
    repo:   "cyanvoxel/vauxhall-obsidian"
    slug:   "vauxhall"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/vauxhall"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/cyanvoxel/vauxhall-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cyanvoxel/vauxhall-obsidian/HEAD/cover.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a clean, cool visual theme with subtle personality for Obsidian. Customize base color palettes, three background intensities, and multiple header styles via the Style Settings plugin; includes color variations and an optional colored sidebar snippet."
}
```
